tools.name: search_drinks
tools.description: Find alcoholic drinks by brand, style or origin, e.g. "titos", "kentucky bourbon". Returns calories, sugar, carbs, ABV, Hangover Index and gluten status per serving.

tools.name: get_drink
tools.description: Full facts for one drink or category: nutrition per serving, seven chemistry factors (congeners, histamines, polyphenols, sulfites, tannins, sugar, additives), allergens, gluten and vegan status, sourcing notes.

tools.name: compare_drinks
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 drinks or categories side by side, e.g. ["vodka", "tequila"] or ["White Claw", "Truly"].

tools.name: rank_drinks
tools.description: Rank drinks by calories, sugar, carbs, Hangover Index or ABV, optionally filtered, e.g. lowest calorie gluten-free hard seltzer. Drinks with no verified figure are left out.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category with its typical ABV and Hangover Index, lowest Hangover Index first.
